Name: Ripped Apart
Description (green text): You are torn to pieces or crushed beyond recovery. It is a sad day when a Hero falls.

Name: Internal Bleeding
Description (green text): Your condition is serious! Wiping blood from your mouth, you assure everyone that you are fine.
Details (black text): Any further Injury Chart rolls are only made on a single D6. This Injury is –1 to the roll to Heal during Surgery at the Doc’s Office in Town.

Name: Mangled Hand
Description (green text): One of your hands is twisted and broken. It’s hard to even hold anything in it.
Details (black text): You have one less slot for equipping Items each turn. Two-handed Weapons may still be used, but they cannot get Critical Hits.

Name: Gouged Eye
Description (green text): Ouch! Your vision is blurred and cloudy as one of your eyes has been scratched!
Details (black text): You cannot get Critical Hits with your Ranged Attacks.

Name: Slashed Leg
Description (green text): A deep and painful cut runs across your leg, making it hard to stand let alone to walk.

Name: Concussion
Description (green text): Your ears are ringing a little and you have a headache that won’t quit!
Details (black text): Until the start of the next Adventure, you are –1 Initiative and roll one less dice on all Skill Tests.

Name: Crushed Arm
Description (green text): Your arm has been bent and crushed a bit. It may even be broken.

Name: Broken Collar Bone
Description (green text): Not particularly debilitating, but it sure hurts! You find yourself cringing a lot from the pain.

Name: Chest Wound
Description (green text): Deep gashes run across your chest, making it hard to turn or twist your body; it’s kind of painful to even breathe.

Name: Wind Knocked Out
Description (green text): You pick yourself up and shake yourself off! It’s a little hard to catch your breath, but you’ll be ok.
Details (black text): There is no long lasting effect.

Name: New Scars
Description (green text): You’re a bit of a mess, but it’s all superficial. In a lot of ways, you look tougher!
